description: Number of distinct records naming the species and matching a topic for each CMP action and each PAN objective. count is the integrated total; count_pubmed is the PubMed result, count_oa the OpenAlex records added to it (articles without a PubMed identifier, matched to topics by keywords in the title or in the abstract, plus two OpenAlex records with a PubMed identifier that the PubMed query did not return) and count_sci the SciSpace records that appear in neither source. count_oa_title gives the OpenAlex contribution when only titles are matched. Snapshot of 14 November 2026.
title: Records per CMP action and PAN objective (PubMed, OpenAlex and SciSpace, deduplicated)

updated.by: Claude, from PubMed, the OpenAlex API and SciSpace
